      "evidence": "Touches CMakeLists.txt by only one line to support socket inspection capabilities required by the P2P change.",
      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "The single-line CMake edit merely follows from the socket inspection additions elsewhere in the patch."
    },
    {
      "name": "p2p",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Carries the P2P area label and modifies block relay logic in src/net_processing.cpp, src/blockencodings.cpp, and src/net.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "speedup",
      "rationale": "Predictively prefilling compact blocks significantly cuts block propagation latency by eliminating an entire GETBLOCKTXN round-trip for most blocks. Live network telemetry cited in the description showed reconstruction success without a round-trip rising from 56.9% to 89.7% while keeping prefill data bounded to the peer's TCP window."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches fuzz targets and unit tests under src/test/ specifically for compact block encodings and socket tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "The test changes accompany the P2P and socket modifications rather than altering test infrastructure or framework runners."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Adds cross-platform socket inspection utilities in src/util/sock.h (+130) and src/util/sock.cpp (+46).",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "new feature",
      "rationale": "The patch adds cross-platform inspection of TCP congestion and receiver windows across Linux, macOS, BSD, and Windows into the shared Sock utility. While specifically implemented to bound compact block prefill sizes, it expands the generic socket utility interface."
    }
